review:
Red Hot Chilli Chickens is a three-pots slot made with Electric Elephant Games, with three nervous chickens above the reels. Mystery symbols reveal hidden chillies, and each chilli feeds a feature pot.

Every full pot brings a bonus round, and up to three bonus rounds can trigger in a single spin, combining features. Five fixed jackpots are available. BGaming rates the game medium volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 96.22% RTP. The pot system gives clear progress towards each feature.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
